column1: # Accepted differences between the stacks, reported by scripts/selftest.py as "known", never as "pass".

column5: python canopen's LocalNode ignores the sub-index of a VAR object (0x2000): an upload of 0x2000:01 returns 0x2000:00 instead of aborting with 0x06090011.

CANopenNode's ASCII gateway starts a download of 1024 bytes without size indication (it streams the hex data); lely's SDO server aborts the first segment into the DOMAIN 0x2005 with 0x06070012 when no size is indicated. The python canopen and lely clients indicate the size and pass.
python canopen's LocalNode aborts an upload of a DOMAIN that was never written (no default) with 0x060A0023 "resource not available"; CANopenNode and lely return 0 bytes.
Lely's dcf-tools (lint) do not know the CiA 306 [<index>ObjectLinks] section: "unknown section in DCF: 2200ObjectLinks", and lint fails. python canopen ignores the section.
CompactSubObj: Lely's dcf-tools create sub-objects 1..n (NrOfObjects, ro); python canopen creates sub 0 "Number of entries" (rw, no default) and only sub 1, generating further sub-objects on access.

CANopenNode's SDO server cannot upload 0 bytes: a read that returns no data is treated as incomplete and aborted with 0x06040047 (CO_SDOserver.c, "bufOffsetWr == 0"). The DOMAIN 0x2005 is empty until written.
